The tour was further enhanced by several delightful surprises, including the Rhine River boat ride, the Titlis Sky Flyer experience, and the Vatican tour, all of which added exceptional value to the journey. Special recognition goes to Ashish for his meticulous planning, seamless coordination, and flawless execution, which ensured that every aspect of the trip was well-managed and professionally organized. His passion, helpful nature, and extensive knowledge greatly enriched the experience. The insightful information he shared about the history, culture, traditions, and significance of the places we visited helped us gain a deeper appreciation of each destination. Overall, this was an outstanding travel experience that combined comfort, organization, and cultural enrichment. I would highly recommend this tour to anyone seeking a comprehensive and immersive introduction to Europe along with value for money. Best Wishes to Team of Travel Experts India for their efforts and wish them more success in all the future endeavors. Warm Regards, Shipivisht Lal, Thane. ( Europe tour 28th May to 8th June)

featured_reviews.review_text:
We booked train tickets and a cab service for our Shoja–Jibhi trip, including pickup from Chandigarh to Ambala and local sightseeing. Unfortunately, our experience was extremely disappointing.

The driver assigned to us was uninterested throughout the trip. He arrived late for pickup, which forced us to spend extra money to reach our hotel. Despite having a detailed itinerary with 4–5 places planned per day over 4 nights, we were barely able to visit 3–4 places in total because the driver was unfamiliar with the destinations and repeatedly stated that he was not aware of them.

Additionally, our return train tickets from Ambala Cantt to Mumbai were not confirmed. We had to travel in RAC, adjusting on a single seat despite paying ₹10,000 for two 3AC return tickets mumbai to chandigarh and return. This was highly inconvenient and not what we paid for.

Toward the end of the trip, the driver also requested us to arrange another cab for a one-hour stretch so he could take other passengers on his way back. Being in an unfamiliar location, this was extremely uncomfortable and inappropriate, as he was the only point of contact we had.

Overall, the service we received did not match what was promised or paid for. I strongly suggest that you ensure drivers are professional, informed about the destinations, and genuinely interested in providing good service.

We request you to review this matter seriously and provide appropriate compensation or resolution..

featured_reviews.name: saili prabhu
featured_reviews.review_text:
I celebrated New years with The Backpacker Co team on their Capital Games Itinerary (Amsterdam~Berlin~Prague~Budapest) and it has been one of my most memorable trips so far. The best thing about their itineraries is in every city they plan the tour of the major highlights and then give you free days to do your own thing (With recommendations from the team of course). This way you get to see the touristy stuff in each city but also get enough time to explore on your own (something that is not very common with group tours)
Everything was very well organized- the hostels, the city tours, the intercity travel and a special shoutout to Merlene who accompanied us on the tour. She knew all about the places to visit and helped us plan our free days. I had the time of my life and I will definitely will be taking more trips with them :)

featured_reviews.name: Deepak Kothari
featured_reviews.review_text:
Enjoyed the trip of capital games Europe .
Nice organisation , nice hostels and excellent company . Only thing I am apprehensive about is their age criteria . Merlene , our tour guide was superb and has made me create a lifetime memory of this trip . She was always very helpful and polite inspite of getting injured at the trip .
Overall - mind blowing experience. Just would ask them to revise their age criteria .

featured_reviews.name: Diya Khatri
featured_reviews.review_text:
Hey there fellow travelers! We reached out to backpackerco for our travel to Finland and I can assure you that that from start to finish, it was a blast!

First off, let's talk about the planning process. Every little detail was thought out, from where we stayed to the activities planned. Now, onto the actual trip. We explored the stunning Finnish wilderness, chased the Northern Lights like pros, and indulged in some seriously delicious local cuisine. Plus, our guides were total legends - knowledgeable and friendly.
So, if you're thinking about visiting Finland (and you totally should), do yourself a favor and book it with backpackerco. Trust me, they'll take your adventure to the next level. Kiitos, guys, for the memories of a lifetime!

featured_reviews.name: Nitesh Gupta
featured_reviews.review_text:
I had the pleasure of going on a group trip to Japan last November with the Bagpacker Co, and I must say it was an unforgettable experience. Merlene, played a crucial role in ensuring that everyone had a fantastic time throughout the trip. Her dedication to managing people and ensuring everyone's comfort and enjoyment was truly commendable.

Japan itself was absolutely breathtaking, and I had one of the most wonderful times exploring its rich culture, stunning landscapes, and vibrant cities. But what made the trip even more memorable was the opportunity to meet and connect with so many cool people along the way.

Overall, I cannot recommend The Bagpacker and Co highly enough for wonderers like myself. Thank you for the unforgettable memories!

featured_reviews.name: Namrata Sarkar
featured_reviews.review_text: I had the pleasure of joining their group trip to Japan (Sakura edition, March 2024). Since this edition had only 5 people (all women) joining the trip, there was no trip leader assigned. However, the support provided by the team pre-trip as well as throughout the entire trip in Japan was immaculate. The itinerary was perfectly planned - their dossiers ensured that we visit most touristy places while also having some free time to explore on our own. There was a small hiccup that we faced in Osaka (majorly because of language barrier) but the Backpacker Co smoothened things out all the way remotely from India. 10/10 would definitely recommend!

featured_reviews.name: Hemant Chhawlla
featured_reviews.review_text: I recently went on a Finland backpacking tour with The Backpacker Co. as a solo traveler and had an incredible experience. The company excels in bringing together like-minded backpackers, creating a vibrant and friendly group atmosphere. A special shout-out to Althea, who traveled with us. Her guidance and assistance throughout the trip were outstanding. She played a pivotal role in making this journey memorable. Highly recommend The Backpacker Co. for anyone looking for a well-organized and enjoyable backpacking adventure.”

featured_reviews.name: Varun Subramanyam
featured_reviews.review_text:
Had been to Japan in Nov-2023, through TBC. The tour was nicely planned and coordinated. The arranged stays were unique and comfortable.

They have curated an itinerary such that you’ll have enough time to explore Japan by yourself, in addition to the group tours planned by them. Found that to be interesting and accommodative!!

Met a bunch of like minded people on the trip! Socialising with them in an unknown country helped in knowing each other better! Met as strangers, came back as friends!!

Overall, enjoyable! Thank you TBC :)

featured_reviews.name: Karthik nandam
featured_reviews.review_text:
I recently had the pleasure of embarking on a European adventure with a group of 10 strangers, guided by an exceptional tour coordinator. We explored the vibrant cities of Amsterdam, Berlin, Prague, and Budapest, and I must say, the entire experience was unforgettable!

Each city offered its own unique charm, from the picturesque canals of Amsterdam to the rich history of Berlin, the fairy-tale atmosphere of Prague, and the stunning nightlife of Budapest. We had lot of time to explore our interests and soak in the beauty of cities at our own pace, which I think is the best way to experience the city.

The group dynamic was fantastic; we quickly bonded and it was a smooth ride thereafter. Akanksha, our tour coordinator was great, in the way she managed the entire trip, although this  being her first project. Their enthusiasm and knowledge really enhanced the trip.

Overall, this was one of the best travel experiences I've had. I highly recommend this company to anyone looking to explore Europe in a self paced manner with a friendly, and fun group!
